objective: Re-skin the hydragrow-frontend UI to pixel-align with the Figma Hi-Fi — Full App (v1) canvas (node-id=213-2, screens D1-D17) using the 3-tier green hierarchy and Figma design tokens. Markup/classes only - no behavior, IR, or API changes. Phase A (token layer + shared primitives + navigation) evidenced in this PR; later phases flip evidence_required and add evidence rows.

acceptance.criterion: App.css @theme defines the Figma token set with exact hex values (page-bg #DCF0DC, border/line #E4EFE6, primary #15803D, primary-deep #14532D, status/success #047857, pill #D1FAE5, faint #7C9385, toggleoff #D9E5DB, surface-muted #F1F6F2, warn-deep #92400E, config #4338CA, config-soft #EEF2FF).
acceptance.verification: grep App.css @theme block; production build emits utilities bg-page-bg, border-line, text-faint, bg-pill, text-status, bg-toggleoff, text-warn-deep, bg-primary-deep, text-primary-deep in dist CSS.

acceptance.criterion: Shared component classes (.ui-card, .ui-input, .ui-state, .page-header-title/icon/subtitle, .farm-section-title, .farm-muted-panel, .ui-tabbar/.ui-tab/.ui-tab-active, .ui-btn-primary, .ui-btn-outline, .ui-btn-danger, .toggle-checkbox) use the Figma tokens (border-line, surface-muted #F1F6F2, primary-deep CTA/tab, error danger).
acceptance.verification: grep App.css @layer components; build emits the classes.

acceptance.criterion: Primitives follow Figma sizes/colors: Switch is a 38x22 toggle (ON bg-primary #15803D, OFF bg-toggleoff #D9E5DB, 18x18 white thumb); StatusPill is borderless 10px semibold pill (sending #FFFBEB/#92400E, accepted #D1FAE5/#047857, error #FEE2E2/#DC2626); TabShell renders pill tabs with ui-tab-active primary-deep.
acceptance.verification: Vitest StatusPill.test.tsx, Switch.test.tsx (new className assertions), TabShell.test.tsx.

acceptance.criterion: MainLayout mobile header shows a dot-prefixed status pill (online bg-pill/text-status, offline #FEE2E2/error) and the bottom nav is the Figma dot+label pill (container bg-line/80, active dot/label primary, inactive faint); desktop sidebar keeps existing emerald active style.
acceptance.verification: Vitest MainLayout.test.tsx + new bottom-nav className assertion.

acceptance.criterion: CHUAN-GIAO-DIEN-FRONTEND.md documents the Figma Hi-Fi palette, the 3-tier green hierarchy, and the indigo automation-only exception; acceptance + evidence contracts for AUTOMATION-REDESIGN-003 exist and pass local validators; TRACEABILITY.md and CURRENT-STATUS.md carry the requirement.

D1 Dashboard (hero metrics, SensorBentoCard, QuickActionBar, ControlCard pump cards, pumpColors labels) aligns with Hi-Fi: #DCF0DC background, white cards with border-line, titles primary-deep, status text on pill.
acceptance.verification: Vitest Dashboard.test.tsx + grep audit of Dashboard.tsx & components.

acceptance.criterion: D2 Control & Operations (AdvancedDeviceControl pump cards, directional command buttons, PWM/frequency sliders, DosingPopup, StatusPill usage) matches Hi-Fi layout/colors.
